text:
emma: Quick sync  we want to publish next Wed. Need changelog PR and docs anchors for marketing CTAs by EOD tomorrow. Can eng confirm?
drew: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4521  changelog at docs/changes/2026-04-07.md. Requesting a short canary 09:30-10:30 PT day-of.
sam: I can add anchors and a small "try dedicated" snippet. Which anchor text do you want?
emma: Short please: 'Model fallback' and 'Dedicated trial'. Marketing will link those exactly.
drew: Also add a line about fallback to smaller model variant under heavy load. Ops: @deploy-bot can you reserve the canary?
deploy-bot: Canary reserved: 2026-04-07T09:30:00-07:00 to 2026-04-07T10:30:00-07:00. Tag: rc/2026-04-07-web.
viv: Growth needs the final docs URL to wire the nurture form and tag leads. Sam can you include a sample webhook payload?
sam: Will include /docs/dedicated/trial and a sample JSON snippet in the patch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1002
emma: Timeline locked: docs + changelog merged by Tue 20:00 UTC, canary Wed 09:30-10:30 PT, public post Wed 11:00 PT, webinar Thu 17:00 UTC. Deck due Tue 16:00.
drew: Good from eng. I'll merge if no regressions. If we hit issues we revert and push a short webinar-only post.
